name: Somerset Foods
old_description: From order to delivery, we keep it fast, clear, and consistent
about:
Somerset Foods, a family-owned wholesale food distributor, was founded in 1989 by brothers Bob, Randy, and Mike Spitz. Headquartered in Edison, New Jersey, the company serves customers across New Jersey, Pennsylvania, New York, and Connecticut.

The company distributes a broad range of food products, beverages, and concession supplies, including frozen meats, canned goods, single-serve snacks, bulk cereals, fountain syrups, and specialty items such as gourmet popcorn kits and cotton candy supplies. Operations are supported by an online ordering platform and a delivery network that emphasizes speed and consistency.

Customers span child care centers requiring USDA-compliant meals, restaurants and taverns needing steady beverage and frozen stock, schools, concession stands at amusement parks, stadiums, and theaters, as well as youth sports leagues, fairs, festivals, food trucks, farm stands, and seasonal event vendors.

Somerset Foods highlights its decades-long relationships, dependable service, and a risk-free trial offering 10 percent off the first three orders as key differentiators. The business stresses fast, clear, and consistent order-to-delivery execution.
